name: slashphoto
description: Open-source photography galleries, client proofing and photo sales for WordPress.

scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/slashphoto wp i18n make-pot . languages/slashphoto.pot --exclude=vendor,node_modules,tests
scripts.i18n:build: npm run i18n:pot && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/slashphoto bash -c 'wp i18n update-po languages/slashphoto.pot languages/ && wp i18n make-mo languages/ && wp i18n make-php languages/ && wp i18n make-json languages/ --no-purge'
scripts.seed: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/slashphoto wp eval-file bin/dev-seed.php
